Rule.name: Example - BuildMap Normalize

Argument.name: log
Argument.Description: The log object associated with the SailPointContext.

Argument.name: context
Argument.Description: A sailpoint.api.SailPointContext object that can be used to query the database if necessary.

Argument.name: cols
Argument.Description: Ordered list of the column names from the file.

Argument.name: record
Argument.Description: Ordered list of values for the current record.

Argument.name: map
Argument.Description: Map of names/values representing the row.
